title: Ku Angarhela ka Misava
intro: Enkarhini wa miringo leyikulu, munhu la dumeke u nyikiwe ku tala lokukulu ka misava, ndzingo wa ku tlangela ni ku titsongahata. Riendzo ra xifaniso lexi ri tirha tanihi dyondzo leyikulu ya ku hundza ka swilo leswi vonakaka ni vuyelo bya ku tikukumuxa. Pfuxeta vumunhu bya moya-xiviri lowu xitori xa wona xi tsariweke emisaveni leyi nga ehansi ka hina.
clues: A ndzi hanya exikarhi ka vanhu lava kongomisiwaka hi murhumiwa lonkulu.
Allah u ndzi nyike rifuwo lerikulu lerova swilotlelo swa xuma xa mina a swi ri ndzhwalo lowukulu eka vanhu vo tala lava tiyeke.

Vanhu va mina, hi ku tiva rifuwo ra mina, va ndzi tsundzuxile ku lava vutshamo bya Makumu hi leswi Allah a ndzi nyikeke swona naswona ndzi nga rivali xiphemu xa mina xa misava, ni ku endla leswinene tanihi leswi Allah a ndzi endleke leswinene.
Hi ku tikukumuxa ndzi vule leswaku rifuwo ra mina lerikulu ri fikeleriwile ntsena hi vutivi bya mina ni matshalatshala ya mina, ndzi ala tintswalo tihi na tihi ta Xikwembu.
Loko ndzi komberiwa ku hoxa xandla kumbe ku amukela vunyingi bya Allah, ndzi arile hi ku tikukumuxa, ndzi pfumela leswaku nhundzu ya mina a yi ri ya mina ntsena.
Hikwalaho ka ku tikukumuxa ka mina lokukulu ni ku tshikileriwa ka mina, Allah u lerise misava leswaku yi pfula ni ku mita mina ni ndhawu ya mina yo tshama eka yona.

outcome.answer: Ku lovisiwa loku heleleke hikwalaho ka ku tikukumuxa

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
